        4.  WITHOUT additional organic material that degrades the substrate under low oxygen conditions.
    *   Constraint 1: Read ONLY the methodology part (Section 2).
    *   Constraint 2: Answer only "true" or "false".
    *   Constraint 3: No inference, no overinterpretation, be objective.

    *   *Section 2.1 Excess sludge and inoculum*: Describes source of sludge and inoculum.
    *   *Section 2.2 Disintegration methods*:
        *   Ultrasonic treatment: Frequency 20 kHz, power 750 W, amplitude 40%, durations (5-60 min).
        *   Alkaline pretreatment: 6 mol/L KOH solution to reach pH 9-13 for 1 hour.
        *   Combined pretreatment: Alkali + ultrasonication (pH 9, 11, 13 and 5, 20, 60 min).
    *   *Section 2.3 BMP test and analysis*: Describes the setup of serum bottles, inoculum (69 mL), pretreated sludge (30 mL), trace elements (1 mL), N2 gas purging (to establish anaerobic conditions), incubation at 35°C with agitation. Analysis methods for biogas and chemicals.

    *   Is there "direct injection of limited air quantity"? No. In fact, they explicitly used $N_2$ gas purging to *establish an anaerobic condition*.
    *   Are there any other treatments mentioned besides ultrasonic and alkaline? No.
    *   Does it mention microaerobic conditions? No.

    The methodology describes ultrasonic treatment and alkaline treatment. It does not describe microaerobic pretreatment by air injection.
